name: finish-reason-retry
summary: Makes pi's built-in auto-retry recognise 'Provider finish_reason: error' (raw OpenAI-completions providers, e.g. OpenRouter) as a transient error, and makes an exhausted context window visible: when pi auto-compaction is off an overflow error says so and how to recover, a reply clamped by the window headroom is explained from the model's real maxTokens/contextWindow, and a failed compact-and-retry names the way out. Also the turn doctor: one bounded steer (two per user message) when a model returns an empty turn, tool-argument errors rewritten to name the bad fields and the required keys, and a 402 that says how many output tokens the account can afford is retried once with that maximum. Provider failures are classified once (credit, rate limit, server) and offered to provider-router's fallback list. Loaded in subagent children, where the parent otherwise sees only a raw provider error.
